entries.3b50cf1cb09e4651: This is a service that supports the development of functional materials on a one-stop basis. Through a functional component exploration package that comprehensively measures functional active ingredients contained in products, small-scale human trials, and a health claim prediction package, it supports the discovery of new functions of materials and verification of their effects. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥363 million.
entries.4865e685d50f9ef8: This is a contract analysis service that utilizes the company's independently developed high-sensitivity comprehensive analysis technology. It responds to needs such as biomarker exploration and elucidation of mechanisms of action, and is used by pharmaceutical companies, universities and research institutes for purposes ranging from basic biological research to evaluation of drug efficacy and toxicity. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥930 million.
entries.5dfc68372c44a00f: Developers of functional materials, such as food companies
entries.77e5462a06b205fc: A biotech venture originating from Keio University that supports the research and development of pharmaceutical companies, universities, and food companies with metabolome analysis technology that comprehensively measures metabolites.
entries.a467afceba162979: This service, launched in July 2025, supports improvements in productivity for biomanufacturing. By comprehensively and chronologically analyzing metabolites in cells and in culture supernatants, it clarifies components that are depleted or accumulated during culture, thereby supporting the efficiency of substance production by microorganisms and animal cells. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥127 million.
